entries.title: Python 3.11 open
entries.supports: x exclusively creates a file and fails when it already exists.
entries.does_not_prove: Who created the pending file or why an earlier replacement failed.

entries.title: Python 3.11 pathlib
entries.supports: Path.replace replaces an existing file; read_text opens then closes its file.
entries.does_not_prove: Replacement cannot fail on this machine.

entries.title: CPython v3.11.0 internal_rename
entries.supports: This pinned source uses MoveFileExW with MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING on Windows and propagates failure.
entries.does_not_prove: Exact installed patch binary contents or the first error from this run.

entries.title: Microsoft MoveFileExW
entries.supports: Replacement is an OS move option, not an assurance that every invocation succeeds.
entries.does_not_prove: A sharing violation occurred in the saved run.

entries.title: Microsoft CreateFileW sharing modes
entries.supports: Existing handles impose compatible sharing requirements; FILE_SHARE_DELETE concerns rename/delete access.
entries.does_not_prove: The observer or another process held a conflicting handle during this run.

entries.title: Python 3.11 finally clause
entries.supports: A new exception raised in finally propagates with a still-pending exception as context.
entries.does_not_prove: The earlier error survived: run_job can already have converted it to a returned row.
